title: Avoid request waterfalls
guideline: Fetch independent data in parallel (Promise.all / parallel server fetches) instead of sequential awaits

title: Keep bundles small
guideline: Use dynamic import()/React.lazy for heavy, non-critical components (charts, editors, modals)

title: Use Suspense boundaries deliberately
guideline: Wrap slow subtrees in <Suspense> with a meaningful fallback, not the whole page

title: Prevent unnecessary re-renders
guideline: Use React.memo/useMemo/useCallback only where profiling shows real re-render cost

title: Colocate state close to where it's used
guideline: Avoid lifting state higher than necessary; it causes broad re-render trees

title: Cache and revalidate server data deliberately
guideline: Use a data-fetching layer (React Query, SWR, Next cache) with explicit revalidation, not ad-hoc useEffect fetches

title: Use stable keys for list items
guideline: Use a stable unique id as the key prop, never the array index for reorderable lists

title: Avoid hydration mismatches
guideline: Ensure server-rendered and first client render output match exactly (no Date.now()/Math.random in render)

title: Use optimized image components
guideline: Use next/image (or equivalent) for automatic sizing, lazy loading, and format negotiation

title: Scope context providers narrowly
guideline: Split large contexts so unrelated consumers don't re-render on every change

title: Push interactivity to the leaves
guideline: Keep 'use client' boundaries as small/deep as possible in the tree to minimize client JS

title: Keep effect dependencies accurate
guideline: List all reactive values used inside useEffect in its dependency array

title: Virtualize very long lists
guideline: Use windowing (react-window/virtualized) for lists with hundreds+ of rows

title: Prefetch likely next routes
guideline: Use built-in Link prefetching for perceived-instant navigation

title: Wrap risky subtrees in error boundaries
guideline: Add an ErrorBoundary around widgets that fetch external/unreliable data
